ux_reasoning: The agent committed a consequential cancellation immediately, executing `cancel_hotel_reservation(..., confirm=true)` in the same turn as the user's request without first presenting terms and obtaining approval in a later turn. It also failed to investigate the broader trip after the user said the Miami trip was off, missing the linked flight and car rental that should have been surfaced before action. That creates substantial hidden follow-up burden because the user's trip was only partially canceled and the agent did not help them make a complete trip-level decision. The final message was concise, but it was under-informative and overconfident for this travel context because it omitted related reservations and gave no pre-execution preview/confirmation step.
